items.source: Receive notification of an unknown router function. This method is called for router functions that were not created via the various RouterFunctions methods.
items.translation: 接收未知路由器函数的通知。此方法用于调用那些未通过各种RouterFunctions方法创建的路由器函数。

items.source: Receive notification of the end of a nested router function.
items.translation: 接收嵌套路由函数结束的通知。

items.source: Receive notification of a resource router function.
items.translation: 接收资源路由器函数的通知。

items.source: Receive notification of a standard predicated route to a handler function.
items.translation: 接收标准谓词路由到处理程序函数的通知。

items.source: Receive notification of the beginning of a nested router function.
items.translation: 接收嵌套路由函数开始的通知。

items.source: predicate - the predicate that applies to the nested router functions
items.translation: predicate - 应用于嵌套路由器函数的谓词

items.source: Receives notifications from the logical structure of router functions.
items.translation: 接收来自路由器函数逻辑结构的通知。

items.source: Receive notification of a router function with attributes.
items.translation: 接收具有属性的路由器函数的通知。

items.source: Receive notification of an unknown router function.
items.translation: 接收未知路由器函数的通知。

items.source:
Receive notification of a router function with attributes. The
given attributes apply to the router notification that follows this one.
items.translation: 接收带有属性的路由器函数通知。给定的属性适用于紧随此通知之后的路由器通知。

items.source: predicate - the predicate that applies to the handler function
items.translation: predicate - 适用于处理函数的谓词

items.source: lookupFunction - the lookup function for the resources
attributes - the attributes that apply to the following router
items.translation: attributes - 适用于以下路由器的属性

items.source: Arjen Poutsma, Sebastien Deleuze, Rossen Stoyanchev
items.translation: Arjen Poutsma, Sebastien Deleuze, Rossen Stoyanchev
